name: AerioTV Setup
description: Preconfigure a user's AerioTV favorites, group order, hidden groups, and settings. Their AerioTV devices offer Dispatcharr Sync on first launch and start from this setup.
author: jonzey231

fields.label: How it works
fields.description: 1. Pick a user and run Load User Lists, then reload this page. 2. Pick favorites, group order, hidden groups, and settings from the lists. 3. Save, run Preview, then Apply. Anything left on Leave empty or Leave as is is not written.

fields.label: User
fields.help_text: The Dispatcharr user whose AerioTV setup this writes. Becomes a list of users once the plugin has loaded.

options.label: Fill (only add what the record does not have yet)

actions.label: Load User Lists
actions.description: Fills the channel and group lists for the chosen user. Save the user first, run this, then reload the page.

actions.label: Show Channels
actions.description: Lists the channels this user can see, with ids and groups. For reference only.

actions.label: Show Groups
actions.description: Lists the Live TV groups this user can see. For reference only.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Shows what Apply would change, without writing.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Writes the setup to the user's AerioTV record.

confirm.title: Apply AerioTV setup?
confirm.message: This writes the user's AerioTV record. Replace mode overwrites what their devices saved for the sections you filled in.
